days_meaning: each delivery day adds this much cash to your side

messages.text: Hello, and thank you so much for trading with us today — we'd be delighted to offer 42, with delivery on day 10 if that suits you. Our purse is a little tight this round, but we'd love to find something that works nicely for both teams.
Hola. This one is in perfect condition. 87 P, delivery day 10.
